email_login.note: Gold person icon on the Evony loading/connecting screen. icon_offset maps the template top-left to the icon center press point; only visible ~3-10s after launch, before Evony auto-logs in as the previous user.

code_dialog.note: 6-digit verification dialog. keypad = measured digit-glyph centers (phase-A capture). After the 6th digit the dialog shows a readback row ('768208 | Done  Cancel') with the dialer STILL up; the final step is the blue Done text at (605,1146). Legacy 'confirm' (580,1082) is empty dialog surface - do not tap. boxes/load_confirm shared with the load-account step.

login_prompt.note: Same dialog as load_confirm (test-connection flow reads name_roi here).

load_confirm.note: Last step of linked-account login: the DARK overlay 'delete your current progress and load the Lv30 account <name>?' (Cancel left, Confirm right). Template = dialog crop; name_roi = the second text line holding the account name; taps from the captured jblake3 dialog.
